ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a guest room worth the name
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: Someone who cares how the colony treats its guests wants a guest bed in a room the colony can be proud of.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: A room with a guest bed in it reaches {SUBJECT} (impressiveness {TARGET}).

plain.li: When travelers stop here, they should get a bed in a room we'd be glad to sleep in ourselves. Something {SUBJECT}, at least.
Our guests talk about us on the road. I'd like them to talk about the room, and not the draught.
The last guests paid for a bed and got a corner. I was embarrassed for all of us.
[winter] Nobody should come in from the snow to a cold corner. Let's make the guest room {SUBJECT}.
[skill:Social] People remember how they were welcomed. I want the guest room to be {SUBJECT}.
[trait:Kind] A guest who has walked for weeks deserves a good bed. Could we fix up the guest room?

warm.li: I'd like every guest to leave here feeling they were wanted. A {SUBJECT} room would go a long way.

blunt.li: The guest room is an embarrassment. Fix it.

cheerful.li: A proper guest room! Flowers, a soft bed, a lamp. Guests will come just to sleep in it.

gloomy.li: Guests leave here thinking we live like animals. Maybe they're right, but they don't have to see it.

cold.li: A good guest room costs a few days' work and pays in goodwill and fees for years. Make it {SUBJECT}.

plain.li: The guest room is ready. I made the bed up myself.
Now when travelers come, we have a room to be proud of.

warm.li: Thank you. Whoever comes next will sleep well here.

blunt.li: Good. Now we're hosts, not a barn.

cheerful.li: I put a flower by the bed! The next guest is going to love it.

gloomy.li: A nice room. I hope the guests don't break anything.

cold.li: Done. The fees will cover it within a season.

plain.li: Guests will just have to make do, then.

blunt.li: Fine. They can sleep with the animals.

gloomy.li: Nobody here cares what strangers think of us. I suppose I'll stop caring too.

plain.li: About the guest room: still not something I'd want to show anyone.
[promised] You said the guest room would be seen to. Guests are still asking where they're meant to sleep.
